task_completion.description: The experiment is saved to the specified path: ~/PsychoPyExperiments/motion_coherence.psyexp.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The experiment must be saved at /home/ga/PsychoPyExperiments/motion_coherence.psyexp. The conditions file is located at /home/ga/PsychoPyExperiments/conditions/motion_conditions.csv and contains headers 'coherence', 'direction', and 'corrAns'. The RDK component must use these exact variable names preceded by a '$' (e.g., $coherence) to indicate they are loaded from the conditions file.
